verdict.rationale: Orama is a search library and cloud service, so being able to opt out of telemetry is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or an opt-out control. On-premise deployment (orama-docs-8) is a separate deployment feature, not a telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
